title: Steam Navigator damage type content file (Content Schema 2.0)
description: Combat damage types (D1): small registry entries referenced by weapons and defences. The registry deliberately has no damage-type interaction matrix; runtime consumers apply armor_pierce and status metadata. IDs use core:damage_type/*.

color.description: Hit / effect tint (#RRGGBB), shared by weapons that reference this damage type.

armor_pierce.description: 0–1 share of the damage that ignores target armor; the registry keeps this scalar instead of a damage x armor matrix.

status_effect.description: Optional status applied by hits of this type; empty means no status.
